# Version 4.153.0
> **Font selection and GPU reliability** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.153.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates to Skia m153 with font-fallback and GPU reliability corrections. Linux fallback selection can choose a different face. This release also corrects cached-data destruction, glyph-atlas tracking and GPU-buffer failure handling.

## Breaking Changes

- **Pin fonts when fallback selection must be deterministic** — Linux fontconfig now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback. Applications relying on the exact fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics; select an explicit family/style or bundle a typeface when deterministic selection matters. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Engine

- **Skia m153** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 153 without managed API or C ABI changes. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.2.1.300 while the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Bug Fixes

- **More reliable GPU text and failure handling** — Prevents partial glyph-atlas updates from enabling stale location reuse and propagates render-task and submission failures. Checked buffer-upload failures reject affected draws instead of using stale contents, while triangulated paths retain CPU vertices for retry. ([#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))
- **Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim compatibility** — Corrects the BA2007 disabled-compiler-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll on x86, x64 and ARM64, avoiding that transitive-package gate failure without changing the native exports. ([#5120](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5120))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Cached-data destruction ordering** — Releases the native cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owner, avoiding an unlock through freed memory. ([#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

Corrects the Windows libHarfBuzzSharp BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error without changing its exported ABI. Package revision 14.2.1.300 still bundles native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

## Release Candidate 1 (September 6, 2026)

Prepared the m153 line for stable release without additional collected product changes.
